text: Implemented prepared-only WL centering with immutable reference statistics; centered CSR features, H K H Gram, Gram-backed operator, and query cross/features reuse frozen training means while preserving query-only novelSquaredNorm. Typed failures cover empty references and cross/reference mismatches; the centered wrapper is not a context-free WLKernel. engineJVM formatting gates and all 136 engine tests pass.
